verifiedFindings: MDEQ performed one 24-hour wastewater survey beginning May 9, 2018 at 10:20 AM and published the final report June 15, 2018.
The report documents a composite sample before disinfection, post-disinfection outfall grabs, an upstream Clam River grab and a reported 1.975 MGD facility flow.

Reported conventional results include suspended solids 7 mg/L, ammonia 0.12 mg/L, total phosphorus 0.15 mg/L and alkalinity 130 mg/L; the metals table records detections including barium, chromium, copper, zinc, nickel and molybdenum with several other metals not detected.
sourceDefect: The original workbook retains one pre-existing #REF! formula in Table 1 - Composites cell C27, an unused/blank result row. The source was not altered; the official PDF tables render normally.
evidentiaryBoundary: This is conventional compliance sampling. It contains no PFAS analytes and does not establish PFAS presence, treatment removal, discharge concentration, source attribution or a migration pathway.

queueResolution.reason: The report does not provide the missing PFAS influent/effluent/sludge series, receiving-history manifests, receptor well data, hydrogeologic field results or synchronized source-to-receptor PFAS sampling.
